verdict.rationale: EFTPS has public web documentation, so whether it offers llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. A probe of eftps.gov/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, OpenAPI paths also returned 404, and nothing in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation. The documented software channel is downloadable Batch Provider Software, not machine-readable docs for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
